name: PayPal Cashback Mastercard

apr.notes: Variable purchase APR 18.49% (Account Type 1), 30.24% (Type 2) or 33.24% (Type 3) based on creditworthiness; cash advance APR 33.24%; penalty APR 34.24%. Cash advance fee $10 or 5%.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee 3% of each transaction.

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all other purchases everywhere Mastercard is accepted.

categories.label: Purchases when checking out with PayPal

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem cash back to a PayPal balance or linked bank account at any time with no minimum.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. The account agreement covers the PayPal Cashback Mastercard or PayPal Cashback World Mastercard; the package is assigned on approval and not stated up front, so network_tier is none. Requires a PayPal account.
